name: popcomputer-web-demo
description: Demo app showcasing @popcomputer/web with D1 database and Better Auth authentication on Cloudflare Workers

scripts.dev: bun run build && portless run --name popcomputer-web-demo bun scripts/dev.ts
scripts.openapi: bun node_modules/@popcomputer/web/dist/cli/bin.js generate:openapi --app src/index.ts --include /api --title 'Popcomputer Web Demo API' --version 1.0.0-rc.1 --description 'Protected JSON showcase for @popcomputer/web' --output openapi.json
scripts.verify: bun run build && bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run check && bun run openapi:check && bun run test:worker && bun run verify:assets && bun run deploy:dry
scripts.secret:generate: openssl rand -base64 32 | wrangler secret put BETTER_AUTH_SECRET
scripts.setup: bun run db:create && bun run secret:generate
scripts.deploy: bun run build && bun run db:migrate && wrangler deploy

DB.description: D1 database for Better Auth users, sessions, rate limits, and application projects.

BETTER_AUTH_SECRET.description: Authentication secret with at least 32 characters of high entropy. Generate one with `openssl rand -base64 32`.

APP_ORIGIN.description: Canonical public HTTP(S) origin of this Worker, including a non-default port when present and no trailing path (for example `https://demo.example.com`).

ENVIRONMENT.description: Closed deployment mode. Use exactly `production` for deployed Workers or `development` locally.
